title: Reuters story quoting Flavio Estrada that the mummies are dolls

tellings.quote: In early 2024, Reuters published this about the Nazca mummies. They're not extraterrestrials, they're dolls made from animal bones from this planet joined together with modern synthetic glue, said Flavio Estrada.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls that in early 2024 the news agency Reuters ran a story about the Nazca mummies, small three-fingered bodies from Peru that some say are not human. In it, a man named Flavio Estrada is quoted saying they are not extraterrestrials but dolls made from animal bones from this planet, joined with modern synthetic glue.
